title: Accuracy and Completeness of Four Artificial Intelligence Chatbots in Assisting Diagnosis and Treatment of Post-traumatic Endodontic Sequelae
html: This study aimed to evaluate the accuracy and completeness of the answers generated by four freely available artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots regarding the management of endodontic sequelae in traumatized permanent teeth and the regenerative endodontic procedure, analyzing their performance by question type and over time.
